fact: Car 6 made more than one change of direction to defend its position
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, and in-car video evidence. Car 6 was defending his position against Car 16 on the straight prior to Turn 13 and made more than one change of direction.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 6 More Than One Change Of Direction
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
